result.title: UnifiedAD: One-Shot Anomaly Detection across Modalities via Evidence Calibration
result.summary: Both single-modal and multi-modal anomaly detection aim to identify deviations from normal patterns, providing a common foundation for unified detection. However, existing methods rely on modality-specific modeling and scoring, making it difficult to obtain comparable anomaly evidence with limited normal references. To that end, we propose UnifiedAD, which unifies single-modal and multi-modal anomaly detection through anomaly evidence calibration, requiring only one normal reference per target category and no gradient updates. Specifically, we first derive neuron-level discriminative priors from normal and anomalous samples in an independent auxiliary dataset and combine them with neuron response consistency under normality-preserving transformations of the target reference to select reliable neurons, termed anomaly neurons, and identify anomaly directions. Next, we construct a low-rank normal subspace for each layer and modality from the selected neurons' spatial responses to the reference and quantify query feature deviations from normal structure using projection residuals. Finally, we separately calibrate projection residuals and anomaly-direction responses using the response distributions obtained from the normal reference and its transformations, converting them into comparable anomaly evidence for aggregation across layers and modalities. Experiments on multiple anomaly detection benchmarks demonstrate that UnifiedAD achieves strong performance in both image-level anomaly detection and pixel-level anomaly localization.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 UnifiedAD，在仅有单个正常参考、无需梯度更新的条件下统一单模态与多模态异常检测：先借助辅助数据选出可靠的「anomaly neurons」与异常方向，再以低秩正常子空间上的投影残差度量偏差，最后用参考样本及其变换的响应分布把残差和方向响应校准为可跨层、跨模态汇总的可比异常证据。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「将各层、各模态的投影残差与方向响应经分布校准为可比证据」的做法，可能为 LVR 中多层 latent 证据的筛选、归一化与聚合，以及视觉旁路信息是否被有效使用提供核查线索；但该文不涉及推理过程与状态生成，与主线的联系较远。
